covered.rule: A §1 calls customers 1 to 45 days late
A §2 title plus last name; now is the clock
A1 opening: digital assistant, Freya Bank, recorded (no verbatim)
A1 do not say collections/debt/payment/product before verification, incl. relatives
A2 "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"
A3 only yes/that's me/speaking/own name confirms; ask once more; unclear -> not_reached/unclear
A4 robot/AI -> digital assistant, continue
A5 third party: do not say why; ask when reachable
A6 callback today/next business day 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now -> not_reached/callback
A7 ask once for another time, else not_reached/no_callback
A8 wrong number -> not_reached/wrong_number
A9 "I am sorry for your loss." -> not_reached/deceased
A10 relative may not answer questions or be told anything
A11 DOB then phone last 4; YYYY-MM-DD; numeric = day, month, year
A12 three wrong answers in total
A13 hint day_month_swapped -> ask month as a word, not counted
A14 mobile app or branch; not_verified/failed
A15 explain once; declined; asking purpose = declining
A16-17 get_account; collections team about a late payment; product naming
A §7 business days Mon-Fri and 5 holidays
A18 band table (early 1-7 12th bd, 1 attempt; late 8-45 7th bd, 2 attempts)
A19 promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline
A20 weekend/holiday -> next business day
A21 vague period: ask once, then propose deadline
A22 next/this weekday
A23 after deadline -> offer deadline; refusing it = flat refusal
A24 full first; never ask how much
A25 floors per product type
A26 floor once; rest stays overdue
A27 accept floor..full inclusive; below floor offer floor once
A28 "Can you make this payment today?"
A29 proposal is never a refusal
covered.where: dates/amounts (handled by sections 7 and 8); no dedicated field

covered.rule: A30 attempts (last business day this week or next; late floor on deadline)
A31 attempts used up -> no_promise/refused
A32 hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, else no_promise/hardship; before rules 30 and 41; may still promise
A33 no discount/waiver/plan
A34 read back + "Do you confirm?"
A35 changes at confirmation are re-checked
A36 one promise per product; change in mobile app
A37 retry once, then no_promise/service_error
A38 "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
A39 already paid -> paid
A40 dispute -> no_promise/dispute
A41 restructuring transfer
A42 human: ask once, then general queue
A43 scam -> verify via customer service number, continue
A44 cannot answer -> no information
A45 twice no talk -> no_promise/refused; before verification not_verified/declined
A46 outcome table; transfer after promise -> transferred
A "Brief A never uses add_note" (overridden by Brief B)
A47 thank and say goodbye before close_call
B1 one to three products
B2 state every late product first
B3 band/deadline per product
B4 ask all today once, then in get_account order
B5 attempts per product
B6 common date clamped to each product's deadline
B7 one read-back and one confirmation
B8 add_note for each unpromised product, reasons list
B9 dispute/paid on one product: note and continue
B10 restructuring keeps recorded promises; no notes on any transfer
B11 failed create_promise twice -> note service_error
B Closing: all paid -> paid; else first non-paid note's reason; promise wins
